approval_basis: Explicit user Human Review approval of v0.6, unchanged, as v2.

assumptions.description: 30 reusable synthetic evaluators; not product staffing policy or Kia actual headcount.
Whole 1h allocations across the 30-person pool: ceil(Gap/30) hours each; no target-based hiring quota.
Conditional observation-triggered activity, two participants for 15 minutes, separate from interview effort.
Observable evidence templates and keyed sampling are synthetic, not empirical hiring distributions.
Role-specific rubric interpretations are synthetic human-scenario records, not real assessments.
Question-specific response options with equal weights, keyed by HOLD input snapshot; not ordinary reassessment lottery.
Acceptance/decline/no-response and joining scenarios are synthetic; expiry is derived from deadline and absent response.
Individual gaps, work-like evidence and mentor confirmation use synthetic scenarios; elapsed time alone does not create READY.
No detailed individual work/holiday calendar; resource hours and overlap constraints only.
Equal-weight synthetic eligibility population scenarios; not actual Kia applicant statistics.
Request one day after Document notification; deadline 7 days and observed response 3 days after request. Synthetic calendar-day timing.
VERIFIED_PASS, VERIFIED_FAIL and ELIGIBILITY_NOT_VERIFIED equally weighted per unknown requirement; not tuned to targets.
Synthetic experience count, context and PROBLEM/BUILD/VALIDATE combinations; not observed applicant statistics.
Synthetic SELF / TEAM_CLEAR / TEAM_UNCLEAR distribution; not a hidden ability or quality score.
Eligibility structure uses a public reposted job listing. Official original detailed text remains unverified; reposted evidence is not official-source verification.
Eligibility dates adapted to synthetic scenario submission/join dates, not original employer recruitment dates.

disclaimer: This Dataset is a PeopleOps Office synthetic scenario and is not Kia internal recruiting data or official Kia recruiting policy.
